description: This file defines the CampaignLog class, a model representing campaign log entries within the SuiteCRM system. It extends the SugarBean base class and includes properties for campaign-related data, as well as methods for retrieving and formatting related information such as recipient names, email addresses, and linked entity details. It also contains logic for querying associated records like accounts, contacts, leads, prospects, campaign trackers, and emails.

classes.name: CampaignLog
classes.description: Represents a log entry of campaign activities in SuiteCRM, with properties mapping to the campaign log database table and methods for retrieving related data and performing lookups.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Retrieves and formats list view data for a campaign log record, including recipient name, email, and marketing name, based on related entity IDs.

methods.name: retrieve_email_address
methods.description: Fetches the primary email address associated with a given target ID.

methods.name: get_related_name
methods.description: Static method that returns the display name or URL of a related entity based on the related ID and type.
